notes: In crates/transit/tests/rnews_ingest.rs line 9+116, the E2E test uses reindex::extract_message_id_bytes (non-folding, uses String::from_utf8_lossy+.lines()) to extract Message-IDs from parsed articles. But rnews_main.rs (production code) uses ingestion::extract_body_msgid (RFC 5322 folding-aware). These are two different implementations. The test exercises check_ingest with the weaker extractor as the msgid argument. For the specific test fixtures used (non-folded headers) the outputs happen to match, so the test passes. But the divergence means folded-Message-ID articles are not tested through the same code path as production, and the test oracle is not independent -- it is derived from a different (weaker) code path rather than a known-good external value. Fix: replace extract_message_id_bytes with extract_body_msgid in the test, or add a folded-header test case that would expose the discrepancy.
title: rnews_ingest test uses non-folding extract_message_id_bytes instead of extract_body_msgid
